name: Stahlbau Ganghofer-Lenz GmbH
summary: Stahlbau Ganghofer-Lenz is a family-owned sheet-metal and welding shop founded in 1968, with 110 staff and €11.3 M turnover. It is our single source for the welded, painted base frame HN 100 (part:330011, ~€384k/yr). Its credit index is moderate and stable at 251 and its equity ratio is 25.6%, but in June it asked us to pay within 10 days in exchange for a cash discount, while we pay 89% of invoices late.

situation.decision_maker: Most likely the owner or managing director (family-owned GmbH, 110 staff, no group parent). No named sales contact appears in the dossier.

negotiation_pattern: It opens its own annual renewal offers modestly (asks of -3.9%, +3.1% and -0.7%) and settles about 2.3 points below its ask: -6.6%, 0.0% and -1.9%. When it asked for an increase (+3.1%), it accepted 0.0% rather than escalate. It is cooperative and gives way under reasoned pressure. It has proactively raised payment speed, with a skonto offered in return.
wants: faster payment (10 days) – it offered a skonto for it
reliable, on-time payment from us (we pay late 89% of the time, 4.4 days on average)
steady volume and continuation of the framework beyond 2027-06-30
fair, respectful treatment as a long-standing family supplier
protects: unit_price beyond a moderate cut (it has already conceded -1.9% for 2026 and -6.6% earlier)
liquidity: it will resist longer payment_days
the contractual price mechanics: prices are fixed per calendar year and changes need 90 days' notice before year-end

trades.give: payment_days 30 → 10, with a firm commitment to pay on time
trades.get: a skonto, or an equivalent unit_price reduction for 2027, anchored clearly above our cost of capital
trades.why: It asked for exactly this, and its value to a family firm with 25.6% equity exceeds our interest cost.

trades.give: contract_months: extend the framework beyond 2027-06-30 (e.g. +24 months)
trades.get: unit_price held or reduced for 2027, plus an OTD/lead_time commitment towards the 95% target
trades.why: Volume security matters to an owner-led firm, and we are single-sourced with 100% quota anyway.

trades.give: volume_per_year: a confirmed annual forecast of ~2,100 pcs
trades.get: ppm_commitment back below ~500 and on-time delivery ≥95%
trades.why: Ppm doubled from 486 to 949 and OTD of 88% is below target. Forecast security helps it plan and fix this.

arguments.point: We are ready to meet your request for 10-day payment and to fix our late-payment record, in return for a cash discount reflected in the 2027 price.
On-time delivery is 88% against the agreed 95% target, and ppm has risen from 486 to 949. Improvement commitments are part of a fair deal.
We offer continuity: a stable spend of €364k, €380k and €384k over three years, and a possible framework extension.
Hollerau owns the tooling for part:330011, so the part is transferable. Mention this lightly and only if needed.

avoid: Aggressive price demands or threats to resource: it is a family firm that has cooperated every year, and pressure risks goodwill on a sole-sourced part.
Asking for longer payment terms: it signalled a cash need.
Ignoring our own late payments (89% late): it weakens our position on any quality or OTD complaint.
Missing the contractual notice timing: price changes for 2027 need written notice ≥90 days before year-end (around 2 Oct 2026).
tone: Personal, respectful and partnership-oriented. Acknowledge the long relationship and its payment request first, then put the trade clearly on the table.
red_flags: Single source with no alternative supplier for an A-class part (quota 100%, other_sources 0).
Delivery is unreliable: OTD 80.8–88.0% against a 95% target.
Ppm roughly doubled from 486 to 949 within a year.
Liquidity is moderate: equity 25.6%, credit index 251 (stable but not strong), and it requested faster payment.
The notice deadline for 2027 price changes under clause 3.1 is effectively now.

evidence.claim: The supplier asked for invoice payment within 10 days in exchange for a cash discount.
We pay late in 89% of cases (4.4 days on average) and have never taken a skonto.
It is family-owned, founded 1968, with 110 staff, €11.3 M turnover, 25.6% equity ratio and a credit index of 251, unchanged over 12 months.
Past renewals settled below the supplier's ask: -0.7% → -1.9%, +3.1% → 0.0%, and -3.9% → -6.6%.
Prices are fixed per calendar year, with 90 days' notice required for changes. The framework runs to 2027-06-30 and auto-extends by 12 months.
OTD was 88.0% and ppm 949 in 2026Q3, against a 95% OTD target and a €150 fee per complaint.
Single source at 100% quota with Hollerau-owned tooling. Current price is €181.29/pc.

indicators.credit_index: 251 (12 months ago 251; higher is worse, >300 weak)
indicators.scorecard_trend: 2025Q4 green (otd 80.8, ppm 486) → 2026Q1 green (otd 83.3, ppm 981) → 2026Q2 green (otd 87.5, ppm 997) → 2026Q3 green (otd 88.0, ppm 949)
